authority: Static House Tang administrative program rules. This file registers lawful program templates and treasury-safety policy; it does not prove that any campaign program has been accepted or opened.

treasury_safety.rule: A new discretionary House program may receive at most the registered fraction of cash remaining after the protected stable-expense reserve. Opening a program reserves no money and spends nothing by itself.

field_preparation.rule: An explicitly requested House Tang campaign-preparation stage may load at most seven days of departure food and fodder from exact House stores. It may form already-conserved Tang Wei personal-force manpower and issue only exact registered stock. Missing equipment remains a persisted shortfall rather than being manufactured by narration.

sword_manor_initiates.intake_rule: House-requested intake may fill only an exact existing trainee vacancy and must consume conserved Qin population. It never grants training time. Existing trainees continue only through the normal Sword Manor training cycle.

sword_manor_officer_cadre.representation_rule: Sword Manor army commander/deputy are named full characters outside the 30,000 disciple fighting number. Internal 1,000/500 officers are represented conserved disciples; 100-man and below remain aggregate unless salient.

standing_establishment.command_count_rule: army/unit commander and deputy excluded from fighting troop numbers; internal 1,000/500 commanders drawn from fighting troop counts.
